object: CAND-ND-1, projection-multiplicity ladder. Take a set of plaintexts whose pairwise differences all lie in the diagonal subspace D_0 (bytes 0,5,10,15). Encrypt r rounds. Project each ciphertext onto ciphertext word 0, the inverse-ShiftRows diagonal {0,13,10,7}. Count colliding PAIRS in that 32-bit projection.
measured_by: dispatching session (Bash), own from-scratch implementation - coordinator-side corroboration, NOT independent validation
why_this_statistic: DETERMINISTIC. It has no detection floor, unlike the statistical measures this campaign has been burned by: a density statistic once read 0.4995 on a random function against 0.4996 on AES and a closure had to be withdrawn. A collision count of exactly zero against a Poisson mean has a tail of e^-mean and cannot be a blunt-instrument artifact.

r3.note: ~2^31 EXCESS, not a deficit - the opposite direction

THE_LADDER_at_N_2e20.shape: NON-MONOTONE: 0, huge excess, 0, then generic. A monotone decay would have been the artifact tell; this is not that shape.

ROBUSTNESS.r4_at_N_2e24_three_keys: 0 collisions, max multiplicity 1, against a null expectation of 32768
ROBUSTNESS.interpretation: The map from a diagonal coset to ciphertext word 0 at 4 rounds is INJECTIVE - perfectly, on every key tested, over 2^24 sampled points.

DATA_COMPLEXITY.note: ~2^19 chosen plaintexts give a 2^-46 distinguisher. For comparison the 4-round integral this campaign built and certified requires 2^32 chosen plaintexts. Both are OUR OWN implementations; no literature comparison is made in either direction.

WHAT_THIS_IS: A deterministic 4-round distinguisher for AES-128, cheap in data, with perfect separation from a matched PRP control.
WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT: DEEPER than what this campaign already had. The integral is exact through r=4 too. This does not extend depth - it is cheaper and deterministic at the SAME depth, and it dies at r=5 exactly where everything else here dies.
NOVEL, or not novel. Not assessed and not assessable here - no primary source is reachable. The symmetric prohibition applies: a recollection may be used neither to promote nor to dismiss.

MECHANISM-EXPLAINED. I measured injectivity; I did not derive WHY the 4-round map restricted to a diagonal coset is injective onto a ciphertext word. The candidate's author derived predictions D1-D6 which the measurement matches, but I have not verified that derivation.

TESTED AGAINST A COMPONENT NULL. Whether this holds for any bijective S-box - i.e. whether it is a fact about the AES round STRUCTURE rather than about the AES S-box - is UNTESTED. This campaign has measured that component nulls often fail to discriminate for structural properties, so that test matters and was not run.
A key recovery. certificate.kind is none.
Any statement about full-round or deployed AES.
prediction_accuracy: The candidate predicted exactly 0 at r=4 and generic at r>=5, and both hold. It predicted 'saturating at r=2' and ~2^24 excess at r=3; measured r=2 is 0 collisions (injective, not saturating) and r=3 excess is ~2^31, not ~2^24. Two of four predictions are off in detail and are recorded as off rather than reinterpreted.
